description: This file implements logging functionalities for Chromium, including log message formatting, severity handling, system error reporting, and platform-specific logging behaviors.

classes.name: LogMessage
classes.description: Handles creation and output of log messages, including severity, timestamp, and source info.

classes.name: Win32ErrorLogMessage
classes.description: Handles logging of Windows system errors.

classes.name: ErrnoLogMessage
classes.description: Handles logging of POSIX system errors.

classes.name: LogMessage::SaveLastError
classes.description: Saves and restores the last system error on Windows.

methods.name: LogMessage::LogMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing log message with source file, line, and severity.

methods.name: LogMessage::~LogMessage
methods.description: Destructor that outputs the log message and aborts if severity is fatal.

methods.name: LogMessage::Init
methods.description: Initializes the log message header with timestamp, severity, and source info.
